segments.name: Europe
segments.description: Makes metal beverage cans, including specialty, slim and sleek cans, for beverage brand owners across Europe.
segments.evidence: The Group's two operating and reportable segments, Europe and Americas, reflect the basis on which the Group's performance is reviewed by management and presented to the CODM.

segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Supplies metal beverage cans, including specialty cans, to beverage producers in North America and Brazil.
segments.evidence: In 2025, specialty cans represented 51% of our total can shipments, with strong representation in both the Europe and Americas segments.

revenueModel.text: Beverage brand owners and producers pay for metal beverage packaging supplied under multi-year and annual supply contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: Over 80% of our revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 is backed by multi-year supply agreements ranging from two to seven years in duration, with the remainder largely pursuant to annual arrangements.
